notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
description:
Cast Goblin Fireslinger by paying {R}.
Goblin Fireslinger enters the battlefield, triggering Obsidian Battle-Axe, attaching it to Goblin Fireslinger and giving it haste.
Activate Goblin Fireslinger by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target player.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Goblin Fireslinger, adding {R}.
Koll triggers, returning Goblin Fireslinger from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
